The duel's gun: two KNN guns, the virtual guns that rate them, and the choice between them.

    ShadowValue
    GUN-7's view of MOVE-8, as the gun is allowed to see it: what firing along an angle is worth in damage we avoid taking, because the bullet's path meets enemy bullets on their way to where our plan puts us.
  • Classes in hadur2.core.gun used by hadur2.core.gun
    Class
    Description
    GunController.Opening
    The gun an opening book asks for until the live virtual guns clearly disagree (ADAPT-1).
    GunController.Stakes
    How the lead-aware regime (POW-7 to POW-9, decided by the core's power policy) bears on the duel's own power: NORMAL keeps 1.20's choice, power-down included; CHAFF fires the minimum power; DEFAULT fires the base power (1.95, or 2.95 inside 150 px) without the cubic power-down, the one thing the regime replaces.
    MainGun.Aimed
    An angle and the mass behind it, see MainGun.aimWithMass(hadur2.core.model.Wave, hadur2.core.knn.KnnView<hadur2.core.model.TimestampedFiringAngle>, java.awt.geom.Point2D.Double, long).
    ShadowAim.Mass
    The gun's probability mass over firing angles: a Gaussian kernel density of points (the main gun's neighbours, or one point at the gun's angle), each weight strong, of bandwidth bandwidth, scaled so that the value is the chance a bullet fired along the angle hits.
    ShadowValue
    GUN-7's view of MOVE-8, as the gun is allowed to see it: what firing along an angle is worth in damage we avoid taking, because the bullet's path meets enemy bullets on their way to where our plan puts us.
